# Marshgate Refrigeration - charge sheets

Circuit charges are measured in imperial gallons on the charging rig.
The parts system lists coolant in fluid ounces.

turns.prompt: Marshgate Refrigeration is writing the charge sheet for chiller CH-9241. The primary circuit takes 385 imperial gallons of coolant. The parts system lists coolant in fluid ounces. How many fluid ounces does the primary circuit take? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
